t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To keep my fingers on the S and K keys and then to also press the space to collect the mushrooms. They also said to take the breaks when they are provided to maintain focus.

vb_textbox.text: Try to keep your fingers on the S and K keys and be quick with your decisions. When you have decided which gnome you want to pick make sure to press the space bar as soon as the basket appears. Also, it may be helpful to try and memorise which gnomes give the most mushrooms.
